subject: SIG: Third-party manifest and evidence batch / upload plan
messages:
From: Lisa Tang <lisa.tang@acme-payments.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-payments.com, security@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: request for subprocessor list + evidence upload timeline

Hi Alex,

Thanks for engaging with Acme's SIG intake. We're preparing the vendor review for our upcoming implementation and need a current subprocessor manifest and evidence for a handful of items: cloud providers, telemetry/monitoring, error tracking, and support tooling. Specifically: 

- A CSV manifest that lists each subprocessor, purpose (hosting/telemetry/support), data classes accessed, and point-of-contact.
- Evidence or attestations for object-store access (S3), telemetry ingestion, and support ticket exports (PDF/attestation or portal link).
- A timeline for when Redwood can upload the package into our SIG portal or share a Drive folder.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the manifest and an initial evidence bundle by EOD Wed 3/18? Also let us know if any of these require an NDA/procurement redline first.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tang
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments

--

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask.

Plan: I will own delivery. Laura (security) and Marissa (GRC) are looped to validate scope; Ben (SE) will supply the vendor inventory and quick notes on data flows. We can provide a manifest CSV and an evidence bundle for your portal by end of day (PST) on Wed 2027-03-18. If procurement needs an executed MSA/NDA before we share, flag it and we'll pause.

Deliverables we'll upload to your SIG portal / Drive:
- redwood_subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv (manifest with vendor contacts + data access categories)
- sig_evidence_package_20270316.zip (attestations, PDFs, short notes)
- s3_audit_evidence.pdf (S3 access audit excerpt)

Next steps for us: Ben will expand the manifest to include telemetry endpoints and support tool attestations. Laura will attach brief control descriptions for telemetry and logging. Marissa will prepare a short cover note for the SIG portal describing tokenization/retention policies.

If that timeline works, I'll upload and send the portal links when complete. If you prefer a short sync to walk through the manifest, I'm available Wed 3/17 afternoon or Thu 3/18 morning.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Alex / team — attaching the expanded inventory and evidence plan. High level vendor list for manifest: 

- AWS (hosting, S3, compute) — data: model weights (no customer PII), ephemeral request caches; contact: infra-partner@redwood.com
- GCP (optional regional failover) — limited to backups; contact: cloudops@redwood.com
- Datadog (telemetry/metrics) — aggregated telemetry, no PII; we retain metrics 90 days
- Sentry (error tracking) — stack traces (redacted), scoped to service ids; 30-day retention
- Zendesk (support) — customer support tickets; exports available per request; contact: support-partner@redwood.com
- Segment (analytics) — product analytics; we do not send raw user prompts to Segment

Notes: I've prepared attestations for S3 access controls and a short runbook describing how we provision telemetry ingestion keys. Those are in sig_evidence_package_20270316.zip. 

Attachment: sig_evidence_package_20270316.zip (contains manifest supplement, attestations, and control summaries)

Ben

We completed the package and uploaded everything to the SIG portal and to a shared Drive folder. Links and a short summary below: 

Uploaded items (attachments included here for reference):
- redwood_subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv — full vendor roster and contacts
- sig_evidence_package_20270316.zip — attestations, control summaries, and runbooks

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=drive-doc-12345

Short note on scope: we included hosting (AWS/GCP), telemetry (Datadog, Sentry), support (Zendesk), analytics (Segment), and a few minor infra tooling contractors. For each subprocessor we listed the data classes and retention windows. Where there is potential for customer PII we included control descriptions and the specific IAM scope.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the manifest and evidence tomorrow morning PST. Otherwise please confirm receipt and any outstanding gaps.
